paragraphs: Munetrix sells K-12 performance analytics that consolidates data into actionable insights. The Academic Module covers academic data from student growth to progress monitoring and needs assessments. Its Financial Module covers building detailed budgets, long-term planning, and financial transparency. An Early Warning Module identifies potential student risks and supports timely interventions.

Founded in 2010 by two educators, the company states a mission to empower educators and organizations by transforming their data into actionable insights. The about page describes changing the way schools and local governments use data. Testimonials on the homepage are attributed to Marquette Public Schools, Gratiot-Isabella RESD, Orion Township and Avondale School District.

quote.text: Built by a team of educators and data scientists, we combine wide-ranging district and school data with publicly available K-12 data to provide real-time, actionable insights on academic, operational, and fiscal performance.
